title: Access language
statement: For a Boolean mode, define a language over Boolean strings by including exactly those strings selected by the index-language construction whose access predicate, evaluated at that mode and the corresponding indices, is true.
caveat: The definitions of the index-language construction and access predicate are not included, so their indexing details are unavailable.
